svg.aria-label: Reviewer agents in Diffo. Your agent picked a set of reviewer agents for the change; you open Add reviewer, the set is already ticked, and Start hands it to your agent, which starts three reviewers as sub-agents. Their faces join the top bar. juno, the General reviewer, comments on line 13; your agent fixes it and answers, and juno confirms and resolves the thread. remy, the AI slop reviewer, flags a TODO on line 14; your agent disagrees, and remy hands the thread to you, marked Needs your decision. iris, on code comments, finds nothing and is done.

g.text: dueAt is midnight, so a todo done at 09:00 on its due day breaks the streak.
Right. It compares days now, and a test covers 09:00 on the due day.
Confirmed: the test fails before the fix and passes after. Resolving.

g.text: A TODO left in: skipped days are ignored, so a missed week keeps the streak.
Ignoring skips is what the issue asked for. The code is right.
Then the TODO or the issue is wrong. That’s a product call, so it’s yours.
